releases.displayName: Update on recent Unity security vulnerability!

items.text: Due to a recently disclosed security vulnerability found in some Unity-built games, we wanted to let you know that we’ve already taken care of it on our side.

There’s no indication that the issue was ever exploited or that anyone was affected, but fixes have already been released - and we applied them right away to ensure that Blood West are now fully patched and secure.

You don’t need to do anything on your side - just keep your game updated as usual. We’ll continue to monitor the situation and follow the latest security recommendations to keep everything running safe and sound.
Stay safe!
Hyperstrange out.

items.text: Howdy!

In the release version of Blood West we've done a reset of the skill point allocations, so players returning to the game can re-distribute them in the redesigned skill-tree. In some rare cases this caused the perks to reset alright, but didn't grant any skill points to distribute. This hotfix alleviates this problem, and addresses some other issues. Full changelog follows:
Long Jack no longer reduces maximum HP of the player on debuff
Alvaro’s Necklace has been slightly buffed
Fixed an issue that could cause players continuing game from previous specific version of the game to not have their perks/levels reset properly
Protagonist moans were too loud, we calmed him down a bit
Emerald Eyes could still provide better prices at shops without being equipped
Specific rope in Chapter 3 was trying to kill players - now it should behave properly
Fixed a bug regarding a full stack of 5 Hellbear Hearts
Fixed a bug with Devil’s Eye constantly giving more HP than it should, after save & load
Fixed bug causing erratic behavior in enemies where they would go idle and lose their inventory (no loot)
If you've experienced the mentioned bug your save file has become corrupt. To fix it make your character rest. Resting will cause the level to reload correctly, effectively fixing the save file.
Again sorry for the distress and inconvenience this bug might have caused some of you.
Good hunting!
Hyperstrange

Today it will get a bit crowded in the changelog, but for the better of course. Some long awaited changes and updates are here, along with some minor fixes.
General gameplay optimization - Through the power of science and a bit of magic you can expect a 20-30 FPS boost on most machines.

New Decal system - Previously blood spurts and splatters had a tendency to ignore laws of physics and geometry. Now they should adhere to nature’s laws. Additionally, we have increased the minimum time before blood splats disappear from 7 to 15 seconds.
Reduced Loading times - This small series of fixes should reduce loading time by 70% (depending on the CPU of course).
Backup saves - The game will now keep backups of 3 last saves. Save will be performed additionally on each player death and during resting.

UI changes - Inventory will now state that double clicking on an item will result in selling / purchasing said item. This feature was already there, but we have decided to add a tooltip, so as to avoid troublesome situations.
Winchester is now a Lever Rifle - God bless trademarks…

Consistency updates - Items will now have the same color of name in the inventory and on tooltip while picking them up from ground also when traveling from chapter 1 to chapter 2 the stash will keep position / orientation of items stored there.
Lip animations - Annabelle will now have proper lip animation when talking (after her mask has fallen off)

releases.displayName: Blood West: Chapter 2 update is here!

items.text: On the 10th of February, Blood West moseyed on down to Steam Early Access. Since then, the posse of the revenant gunslinger only has grown. Currently, folks on Steam have given the game a ratin’ of 91% of positive reviews out of more than a thousand of them. The only complaint was that there ain’t enough of it…
Tonight, on the last night of October, 2022, the dead once more come crawlin’ back from der’ graves to feast on the living with the horrifically huge update to Blood West!

This time players will have to test their grit against the swamps and their lovecraftian denizens. The new location itself is almost twice the size of the original Canyons. The new area is filled to the brim with points of interest, from old fishing towns and alligator farms to a derelict paddle steamer.

The players will also have a chance to run into an old friend as well as meet new fully voice-acted dudes and dudettes who will tell you a tale or two. Tho’ this ain’t gonna be a sightseein’ trip as cultists of cosmic horrors, zombie alligators, specters, and all other nasty varmints will be huntin’ you in these desolate lands.

As in Chapter 1, it’s better to come prepared. New artifacts, potions, and weapons can be found on the swamps or purchased from those who are still breathin’. There’s even a crossbow for those who are feelin’ medieval.

To sweeten the deal, as a part of Steam Scream Sale, Blood West will be available at a 25% discount till the 1st of November, till 18.00 CEST. We have even thrown in a fistful of bug fixes and optimizations for Chapter 1. That's only 24 more hours, so don't waste any time!

Please note, that this is an Early Access update and the game is still in WIP state. There are some things still amiss in this update, and we'll be rolling out subsequent patches as they come (please refer to the release notes below), but we really wanted to make your Halloween special, rather than wait until everything is perfect!
Whole new map!
Bigger than Canyons! (1.5x larger, and more tightly-packed with content)
9 new enemies
5 new NPCs and 1 old friend
5 new types of weapons
11 new unique weapons
25 new artefacts
3 new potions
More than twice as many dialogues
General optimization, including the Canyons
A whole lotta bug fixes
no DE and RU language versions yet (they're on the way - ETA November 14)
some SFX are not final
optimization is not yet final

items.text: It is that time of the year again. Boomercon is upon us! Or Realms Deep 2022, if you will. We've had six announcements this year, so let's jump into it without further ado. This serves just as a summary - more detailed posts will be popping up on appropriate game pages within a day or two. Let's go!

notes.title: INCISION - Early Acces launch + Special Offers!

items.text: Check out our nevest, explosive release! INCISION is a rare gem - a very retro-looking, unforgiving throwback shooter, that's so full of wonderfully-executed ideas, that it feels fresh and juicy. That is if you like your juice in the taste of rust, rot, and horror. The game launched on the day of Realms Deep main event - 16 September, and is already gaining a lot of praise from the players on Steam. If you like games such as DUSK, you can't afford to miss INCISION. And speaking of DUSK - DUSK owners get extra 15% off the price that's been already lowered by 15% in the release week. Similar discount applies for owners of Nightmare Reaper and Hedon, with even more bundles on the way! Get your tetanus shot, and plunge into the horror now!

notes.title: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - Horde Mode announcement

items.text: POSTAL: Brain Damaged has already gotten a small balancing update. Now, on September 19 it's getting another one. Much more substantial - it should help a lot with the balance between exploration and combat, thanks to the new ammo mechanics. Wait, that's not what you just saw in the video above? That's very perceptive! November 10 will mark the release of the Horde Mode in POSTAL: Brain Damaged, so you can spend even more time with the Brain Damaged Dude!

Your favorite eerie wild west stealth-shooter with a bit of a immersive sim aftertaste has exceeded our initial expectations as to the reception and popularity. In wake of such success the Blood West team has been expanded, and the project was granted an extended development schedule, to deliver more content than it was originally intended. The second out of 3 chapters in the story of the Revenant Gunslinger will hit Steam on Halloween, and you'll be getting a map that's 1.5 larger and tighter packed with events and NPCs then the first one.

According to some sources, Supplice is the best-looking game in the entire Hyperstrange catalog. Well, beauty takes time! We've hold off making the announcement of the release date, to make sure Mekworx team has enough time to work their magic. Now, we're happy to announce the date you've been dying to know: 30 march 2023!

notes.title: GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead - new game announcement

items.text: And that's that. We'll be happy to hear your thoughts on our Hyperstrange Discord, steam forums, and clay tablets. Thank you for being a part of the Hyperstrange crowd, and Stay Metal!

A few minor issues were noticed after yesterday's update went live that were calling for a quick fix, and a minor accessibility feature was requested. We were able to patch it all up quick, so we've got a hotfix for you, today. Here's what it brings:
New feature You can now set weapon zoom mode (aim down sights) to function either as a key press or toggle
The Mule perk does no longer extend space in sacks making them act wonky. If you had more items placed in a sack than it should be able to carry, the additional items have been moved to Player Stash
Fixed a bug that caused the NPCs to de-spawn if game was saved exactly at the moment of Player respawning / waking from sleep
Fixed a bug that caused coins to be ignored by the Totem when inside a sack after reload or player death
Fixed sections of the underground temple floor so they generate footsteps and display bullet hole decals
Fixed parts of the tree roots so they generate footsteps and display bullet hole decals
Fixed a bug that allowed for the ammo to be cloned under some rare circumstances
That's it for today, Gunslingers.

You've been fighting relentlessly to take back the frontier from the bloody claws of otherworldly abominations for two full months. And there's thousands of you! We've been blown away by your enthusiastic reception of Blood West and humbled by the overwhelmingly positive reviews. You've been recommending our game to your friends and other Steam players, and it means the world to us. We know we love old-school, immersive gameplay full of stealth, tactics, and exploration - it's nice to know you do, too!
The Skin Collector - enemy concept in the upcoming scenario

Some of you say our western stealth shooter arrived in Early Access in better form than some high-profile games left it. That's a bar set really high, for sure, and we're doing and will continue to do our best to meet your expectations. We don't yet have a set release date for the upcoming content update that will bring about the second playable scenario. Seeing how much you appreciate the fine details of our creation we want to put as much - or more - effort into crafting the next rich and varied part of the world of Blood West.
The Wraith - enemy concept in the upcoming scenario

While we work on the new content we also improve on some aspects of the existing game, because there's always room for improvement, and we're no strangers to early access. Today marks the release of our first regular Early Access update (full changelog below!). It'll be accompanied by a week-long promo matching the release discount of 20%, so all of you who were on the fence with Blood West in the release week and held out until there's more reviews - here's your chance!

Following your generous feedback and going through the many gameplay videos and streams, we've decided our priorities for the first post-release patch. Here's how we're improving on the game's mechanics and introducing some quality-of-life improvements:
A new, alternate bossfight path
Leaning from behind cover (make sure to bind the keys!)
New vendor items - sacks that improve inventory management
By popular demand items in the inventory can now be rotated to improve stackability (have fun!)
You can now bind the key to unload ammo
FOV slider added
V-Sync toggle added
Brightness / gamma setting (does not affect the UI)
ESC key closes inventory/map screen
Trying to bind a key that's already in use will prompt an option to swap them
Keybind menu cannot be closed if not all keys have been set, missing bindings will be highlighted
Improved enemy A.I. - they will react to gunshots in their hearing range, notice if another mob in their line of sight is killed, become alarmed in vicinity of other aggravated mobs
Jim's lucky coin quest is now failable if the player chooses to keep the coin for themselves
Reworked the acid-spitting Humanpede behavior - it should now be more challenging to fight, although it still prefers to avoid up-close combat
Nerfed the Collector perk - it generates less loot
Nerfed the Gotcha! perk - it now provides just longer, not infinite effective headshot distance
Totem blessings no longer stack - you can only have one active at a time
Putting a bow on the ground while it was drawn will return the arrow to the inventory
Removed the Shadow Heart item
Reduced healing items and ammo amount player can find in the game world
Some spelling and grammar corrections (not final)
Loading your game no longer causes FPS to drop
Quitting the game by Alt+F4 combo no longer risks corrupting your save file
The UI prompts display the correct bindings right away, not after game restart as it used to
Ctrl and Shift keys are now bindable
Reloading the boss fight no longer causes wendigo not to spawn properly
Fixed the rare bug that allowed losing or multiplying bandages (and other stackable items)
Fixed the breaking platform in the boss fight which was breaking to quick on subsequent tries
Sliding or running downwards on slopes no longer generates damage to the player
Multiple fixes to the save game functionality
More clear option selection ("Accept" closes the form and saves the changes, "Back" was renamed to "Cancel", acts accordingly)
Molotov burning sound no longer loops on mob impact
Mobs no longer vocalize post-death (which occurred when killed with shotgun or other multi-projectile weapon)
Ghosts no longer leave blood splatter on walls
Sacks - a useful new addition to the player's inventory
Please note that after the patch loading an existing save game will result in the player being re-located to a safe zone, and all the monsters will be re-spawned.

This concludes today's summary. If you have any more suggestions or happen to run into some issues, please make sure to let us know either here, in the game's Steam hub, or in the Blood West channel of Hyperstrange Discord.
